latest.finding: Adrenaline before transport in 58/143 (41%) non-shockable arrests and fluids in 12 (8%); defibrillation in 11/13 (85%) shockable; median scene time 10 minutes; 10/176 (6%) survived to discharge, 6 (3%) with favourable neurology

latest.title: Blood stored on ambulances stays within limits to day 42
latest.finding: All units below the 0.8% haemolysis threshold at day 42, but ambulance storage gave higher haemolysis at day 28 (+0.043 pp) and day 42 (+0.096 pp) and extra microerythrocyte accumulation, mostly between days 28 and 42
